summary: Chelan County, WA 20-foot pole L-4 tower built on Nelson Butte in 1934; abandoned 1953 and now gone, per four sources.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1953 and now gone per FFLOS and FireLookout; WillhiteWeb says abandoned or destroyed that year

visit.trail_note: Gravel roads to the north ridge, where you pull over and park; the old fire break up the ridge is open but regrowing; hike under half a mile (WillhiteWeb, undated)

events.note: Lookout on the butte spotted a fire near a slide across the lake; a crew was sent and the fire came under control (Wenatchee Daily World item of September 1931, as quoted by Washington Lookouts)
A lookout was on Nelson Butte when the fire was spotted
A Chelan camp was working toward Nelson Butte Summit with most of the road to Safety Harbor Creek completed (1933 item quoted by Washington Lookouts)
20-foot pole L-4 tower built; WillhiteWeb says a road reached the site by then
Abandoned in 1953; WillhiteWeb says abandoned or destroyed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: WillhiteWeb says abandoned or destroyed in 1953; FFLOS and FireLookout say abandoned in 1953 and gone. The story gives the 1953 abandonment and the gone status, and reports WillhiteWeb's wording without choosing between abandoned and destroyed.

notes_for_editor: Elevation: the record says 1891.9 m (about 6,207 ft). WillhiteWeb gives Lookout Elevation 6,267 feet (about 1,911 m); not reconciled, so the record was not changed. Check a USGS source before editing. height_m 6.1 is the 20-foot pole height converted; no source gives the total height with the L-4 tower. No access level is recorded because no source states public status. WillhiteWeb's route notes are undated.
